edits.new: 5. Fix the consumed shapes: the case read, the parameter and list reads, the deviation read, the ledger read, the document read, the source-data read and the rule-model read, each with its owner, its use in the legacy criteria, its one-hop budget and the ones whose path no source names (AC5). The source-data read carries the FSD field names as source field names with no view or ACE table read; its party-flag, deceased-marker and freshness fields are confirmed with P1 before the wave 2 system test, and its call-note field with the P5 owner before the shadow screening test. The document read is a contract dependency on rwb-document, and no copy of a document is held in schema rwb_deviation.
